title: Decision: Responding to Potential New International Tariffs
goals: minimize impact on profit margins, maintain competitive pricing, ensure supply chain stability, and protect key market positions

options.title: Relocate Manufacturing
options.description: Shift production to non-affected countries, establishing new manufacturing partnerships in Vietnam and Mexico over 12-month period

options.title: Absorb and Adjust Pricing
options.description: Maintain current supply chain while implementing strategic price increases and cost optimization to offset 15-20% tariff impact

options.title: Localize Production
options.description: Invest in domestic manufacturing capabilities to reduce international exposure, with 18-month transition timeline

options.title: Hybrid Approach
options.description: Combine partial manufacturing relocation with selective price adjustments, while negotiating with suppliers for cost sharing

criteria.title: Financial Impact
criteria.description: Direct cost increases, implementation costs, and impact on margins across product lines

criteria.title: Timeline Feasibility
criteria.description: Ability to implement changes before tariffs take effect and manage transition period

criteria.title: Supply Chain Risk
criteria.description: Potential disruptions, reliability of new suppliers, and quality control challenges

criteria.title: Market Share Impact
criteria.description: Effect on competitive position and potential loss of customers due to price changes

criteria.title: Operational Complexity
criteria.description: Changes required to logistics, inventory management, and production processes

criteria.title: Regulatory Compliance
criteria.description: Ability to meet various international trade regulations and certification requirements

criteria.title: Geographic Diversification
criteria.description: Resulting exposure to political and economic risks across different regions

criteria.title: Customer Relationships
criteria.description: Impact on existing customer contracts and long-term relationship management

criteria.title: Long-term Flexibility
criteria.description: Ability to adapt to future trade policy changes and market conditions
